title: Mount Batur From Above, Indonesia
description: Mount Batur's dark volcanic caldera rises from a wide lake basin seen from a high elevation vantage, the cobalt caldera lake curving below and a trekking lane visible as a pale thread across the dark lava field in crisp morning air. Trekkers deciding whether to attempt the pre-dawn summit hike on Day 4 of a one-week Bali plan will find full logistics — guide costs, start times and fitness notes — in the article.
